thinkdistributedsystems.description_text: This practical book delivers both the big picture view and ground-level details you need to understand the distributed systems you'll encounter on the job. Author Dominik Tornow breaks down distributed system design into useful categories like component and network failures, transactions, durable executions, and distributed consensus. You'll love how the elegant analogies, examples, illustrations, and definitions clarify even the most difficult concepts.

moderncthirdedition.description_text: Modern C, Third Edition is a fast-paced introduction to the C language, with special attention on its most modern features. It starts with a quick review of structure, grammar, and execution and then progresses quickly to control structures, data types, operators, and other core language features. Fully revised for C23, this expanded Third Edition covers compound expressions and lambdas, new insights into approaching program failure, and how to transition smoothly to C23.

grokkingconcurrency.description_text: Grokking Concurrency is a perfectly paced introduction to the fundamentals of concurrent, parallel, and asynchronous programming. In it, you'll learn the practices you'll need to program multicore processors, GPUs, and other high-performance systems. Author Kirill Bobrov skips the math, jargon, and academic language and concentrates on clear, plain-English explanations.

100sqlservermistakesandhowtoavoidthem.human_name: 100 SQL Server Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
100sqlservermistakesandhowtoavoidthem.description_text: 100 SQL Server Mistakes and How to Avoid Them focuses exclusively on the errors that you might, and probably will, make as a SQL Server admin or developer. Real-world examples, code samples, and helpful diagrams make it easy to understand each issue and its solution. You'll learn how to write performant code, design efficient database schemas, implement error handling, work with complex data types, and much more, all in a friendly, common-sense problem/solution format.

cplusplusconcurrencyinactionsecondeditio.human_name: C++ Concurrency in Action, Second Edition
cplusplusconcurrencyinactionsecondeditio.description_text: C++ Concurrency in Action, Second Edition is the definitive guide to writing elegant multithreaded applications in C++. Updated for C++ 17, it carefully addresses every aspect of concurrent development, from starting new threads to designing fully functional multithreaded algorithms and data structures. Concurrency master Anthony Williams presents examples and practical tasks in every chapter, including insights that will delight even the most experienced developer.

blockchaininaction.description_text: Blockchain in Action teaches you how to design and build blockchain-based decentralized apps, and is written in a clear, jargon-free style. First, you'll get an overview of how blockchain works. Next, you'll code your first smart contract using Ethereum and Solidity, adding a web interface, trust validation, and other features until your app is ready for deployment. The only thing you need to get started is standard hardware and open source software.

patternsforapidesign.description_text: API Design Patterns lays out a set of design principles for building internal and public-facing APIs. Google API expert JJ Geewax presents patterns that ensure your APIs are consistent, scalable, and flexible. You'll improve the design of the most common APIs, plus discover techniques for tricky edge cases. Precise illustrations, relevant examples, and detailed scenarios make every pattern clear and easy to understand.

bddinactionsecondedition.description_text: In BDD in Action, Second Edition, you'll learn to seamlessly integrate BDD into your existing development process. This thoroughly revised new edition now shows how to integrate BDD with DevOps and large-scale Agile systems. Practical examples introduce cross-functional team communication skills, leading a successful requirements analysis, and how to set up automated acceptance criteria.

advancedalgorithmsanddatastructures.description_text: Advanced Algorithms and Data Structures introduces a collection of algorithms for complex programming challenges in data analysis, machine learning, and graph computing. You'll discover cutting-edge approaches to a variety of tricky scenarios. You'll even learn to design your own data structures for projects that require a custom solution.

cconcurrency.description_text: C# Concurrency equips programmers with a comprehensive understanding of multithreading and asynchronous programming, focusing on the practical use of the C# async-await feature to simplify asynchronous tasks. It teaches how to avoid common pitfalls, addresses classic multithreading issues like deadlocks and race conditions, and advanced topics such as controlling thread of execution and using thread-safe collections.

grokkingaialgorithmssecondedition.description_text: Grokking Algorithms, Second Edition teaches you important algorithms to speed up your programs, simplify your code, and solve common programming problems. Start with tasks like sorting and searching, then build your skills to tackle advanced problems like data compression and artificial intelligence. You'll even learn to compare the performance tradeoffs between algorithms. Plus, this new edition includes fresh coverage of trees, NP-complete problems, and code updates to Python 3.

grokkingfunctionalprogramming.description_text: Grokking Functional Programming introduces functional programming to imperative developers. You'll start with small, comfortable coding tasks that expose basic concepts like writing pure functions and working with immutable data. Along the way, you'll learn how to write code that eliminates common bugs caused by complex distributed state. You'll also explore the FP approach to IO, concurrency, and data streaming. By the time you finish, you'll be writing clean functional code that's easy to understand, test, and maintain.

data-orientedprogramming_reducesoftwarec.description_text: In Data-Oriented Programming in Java you'll learn what you might have thought was impossible: how to use Java's type system to make code self-documenting, implicit behaviors explicit, and incorrect states impossible to even compile. This practical book teaches you how to use records, sealed classes, and pattern matching to represent the data in your domain, explore data's inherent meaning and semantics, and represent them in their code. Each new concept is fully illustrated with a hands-on example that demonstrates how DOP helps you write scalable, testable, and maintainable code.

cindepthfourthedition.description_text: C# in Depth, Fourth Edition is a revised edition of the bestseller written by C# legend Jon Skeet. This authoritative and engaging guide is your key to unlocking this powerful language, including the new features of C# 6 and 7. In it, Jon introduces expression-bodied members, interpolated strings, pattern matching, and more. Real-world examples drive it all home. By the end of this awesome book, you'll be writing C# code with skill, style, and confidence.

architecturemodernization.description_text: Architecture Modernization: Socio-technical alignment of software, strategy, and structure presents a clear path for upgrading your entire organization when you re-imagine your software. In it, you'll learn to combine practices like Domain-Driven Design, Event Storming, and Wardley Mapping to discover user needs, design optimal architecture, and avoid falling back into old habits. Provocative examples from Danske, Salesforce, the UK Government, and others show the real-world result of each approach, identifying techniques you can apply effectively in your own business.

100javamistakesandhowtoavoidthem.human_name: 100 Java Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
100javamistakesandhowtoavoidthem.description_text: 100 Java Mistakes and How To Avoid Them highlights 100 Java coding errors from beginner missteps to mistakes even Java experts don't know they're making. Each case includes clear examples to show you what to look for and concrete troubleshooting advice. You'll learn to use static analysis tools like IntelliJ IDEA and SonarLint to ensure you're consistently delivering exceptional Java, discover how unit tests and defensive coding can keep your code clean, and even learn to write your own bug-busting plugins.

dockerinactionsecondedition.description_text: Docker in Action, Second Edition teaches you to create, deploy, and manage applications hosted in Docker containers running on Linux. Fully updated, with four new chapters and revised best practices and examples, this second edition begins with a clear explanation of the Docker model. Then, you go hands-on with packaging applications, testing, installing, running programs securely, and deploying them across a cluster of hosts. With examples showing how Docker benefits the whole dev lifecycle, you‚Äôll discover techniques for everything from dev-and-test machines to full-scale cloud deployments.

modernjavainaction.description_text: Modern Java in Action connects new features of the Java language with their practical applications. Using crystal-clear examples and careful attention to detail, this book respects your time. It will help you expand your existing knowledge of core Java as you master modern additions like the Streams API and the Java Module System, explore new approaches to concurrency, and learn how functional concepts can help you write code that's easier to read and maintain.

developers.developer-name: Raoul-Gabrijel Urma, Mario Fusco, Alan Mycroft

100cplusplusmistakesandhowtoavoidthem.human_name: 100 C++ Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
100cplusplusmistakesandhowtoavoidthem.description_text: 100 C++ Mistakes and How To Avoid Them presents practical techniques to improve C++ code, from legacy applications to modern codebases that use C++ 11 and beyond. Author Rich Yonts provides a concrete example to illustrate each issue, along with a step-by-step walkthrough for improving readability, effectiveness, and performance. Along the way, you'll even learn how and where to replace outdated patterns and idioms with modern C++.

looksgoodtome.description_text: Looks Good to Me teaches the considerate, common sense approach to code reviews pioneered by author Adrienne Braganza. You'll learn how to create a cohesive team environment, align review goals and expectations clearly, and be prepared for any changes or obstacles you may face. Along the way, you'll master practices that adapt to how your team does things, with multiple options and solutions, relatable scenarios, and personal tidbits. You'll soon be running highly effective reviews that make your code and your team stronger.

algorithmsanddatastructuresformassivedat.human_name: Algorithms and Data Structures for Massive Datasets
algorithmsanddatastructuresformassivedat.description_text: Algorithms and Data Structures for Massive Datasets introduces processing and analytics techniques for large distributed data. Packed with industry stories and entertaining illustrations, this friendly guide makes even complex concepts easy to understand. You'll explore real-world examples as you learn to map powerful algorithms like Bloom filters, Count-min sketch, HyperLogLog, and LSM-trees to your own use cases.

developers.developer-name: Dzejla Mdjedovic, Emin TahiroviÄ‡, Ines Dedovic

grokkingsimplicity.description_text: The book teaches you to solve the complex timing bugs that inevitably creep into asynchronous and multithreaded code. In advanced sections of the book you learn how composable abstractions help avoid repeating code and open up new levels of expressivity.

feedingamerica.description_text: Feeding America is a nationwide network of 200 food banks that leads the fight against hunger in the United States. Together, we provide food to more than 37 million people through 61,000 food pantries, soup kitchens, and shelters in communities across America. Feeding America also supports programs that improve food security among the people we serve; educates the public about the problem of hunger; and advocates for legislation that protects people from going hungry. Individuals, charities, businesses and government all have a role in ending hunger. Donate. Volunteer. Advocate. Educate. Together we can solve hunger. Visit http://www.feedingamerica.org/. Find us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/FeedingAmerica or follow us on Twitter at www.twitter.com/FeedingAmerica

acingthesystemdesigninterview.description_text: Acing the System Design Interview is a masterclass in how to confidently nail your next interview. Following these easy-to-remember techniques, you'll learn to quickly assess a question, identify an advantageous approach, and then communicate your ideas clearly to an interviewer. As you work through this book, you'll gain not only the skills to successfully interview, but also to do the actual work of great system design.

apachekafkainaction.description_text: Apache Kafka in Action is a practical guide for IT professionals who are integrating Kafka into data-intensive applications and infrastructures. The book covers everything from Kafka fundamentals to advanced operations, with interesting visuals and real-world examples. Readers will learn to set up Kafka clusters, produce and consume messages, handle real-time streaming, and integrate Kafka into enterprise systems. This easy-to-follow book emphasizes building reliable Kafka applications and taking advantage of its distributed architecture for scalability and resilience.

classiccomputerscienceproblemsinpython.human_name: Classic Computer Science Problems in Python
classiccomputerscienceproblemsinpython.description_text: Classic Computer Science Problems in Python sharpens your CS problem-solving skills with time-tested scenarios, exercises, and algorithms, using Python. You'll tackle dozens of coding challenges, ranging from simple tasks like binary search algorithms to clustering data using k-means. You'll especially enjoy the feeling of satisfaction as you crack problems that connect computer science to the real-world concerns of apps, data, performance, and even nailing your next job interview!

modernfortran.description_text: Modern Fortran teaches you to develop fast, efficient parallel applications using twenty-first-century Fortran. In this guide, you'll dive into Fortran by creating fun apps, including a tsunami simulator and a stock price analyzer. Filled with real-world use cases, insightful illustrations, and hands-on exercises, Modern Fortran helps you see this classic language in a whole new light.

Together, we provide food to more than 37 million people through 61,000 food pantries, soup kitchens, and shelters in communities across America. Feeding America also supports programs that improve food security among the people we serve; educates the public about the problem of hunger; and advocates for legislation that protects people from going hungry. dockerfordevelopers2026_microservicespro.human_name: Docker for Developers 2026 - Microservices Project Workshop
dockerfordevelopers2026_microservicespro.description_text: In this comprehensive course, you will learn how to build and deploy a Dockerized microservices application, focusing on API development, authentication services, frontend integration, and deployment strategies. The course begins with an introduction to Docker and its essential tools, followed by detailed guidance on creating Dockerfiles, managing environment variables, and integrating databases and other services within your containers. You will explore key concepts such as Docker volumes, Nginx reverse proxies, Docker networking, and container orchestration. Step by step, you'll containerize various components of your microservices application, from the backend API to the frontend service, making them fully operational within the Docker environment. Throughout the course, you’ll receive practical challenges, including building a mailer service, to reinforce what you’ve learned. The course wraps up with a full deployment workflow, including pushing your code to Git, setting up a production server, and deploying your microservices application to a live environment. By the end, you’ll have the knowledge and hands-on experience to confidently develop and deploy production-ready microservices applications using Docker.

gitopsinpracticewithargocdandargorollout.human_name: GitOps in Practice with Argo CD and Argo Rollouts - The Complete Guide
gitopsinpracticewithargocdandargorollout.description_text: This course is designed for professionals aiming to enhance their skills in modern application deployment and management with GitOps. It covers Argo CD, a powerful continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes, and Argo Rollouts, which enhances application deployment strategies. Learners will gain a solid understanding of core GitOps principles, Argo CD’s architecture, and best practices for scaling deployments. In the first part, you will learn the fundamentals of GitOps, the drawbacks of traditional deployment models, and how Argo CD helps streamline these processes. Through labs and real-world examples, you will install and configure Argo CD, exploring key features like application CRD, syncing, and health status management. Following this, the course delves into advanced features such as Helm integration, sync automation, and managing private repositories. By the end of the course, you will be proficient in orchestrating complex deployments with Argo CD and Argo Rollouts, leveraging strategies like Blue-Green and Canary for traffic management. This course provides a complete roadmap for DevOps engineers to implement GitOps successfully in their infrastructure.

wdc_gamersfororcas.description_text:
Donations to support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are made to the PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the conservation and protection of whales and dolphins. We defend these remarkable creatures against the many threats they face through campaigns, lobbying, advising governments, conservation projects, field research and rescue. Our mission is to amaze people with the wonder of whales and dolphins, and inspire global action to protect them. Our vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

WDC has offices in the UK, US, Germany and South America and currently works on a range of campaigns, including:

  • Ending hunting and commercial whaling
  • Helping to tackle ocean plastic pollution, which poses a serious threat to whales and dolphins
  • Ending  keeping  whales and dolphins  in captivity
  • Tackling the issue of bycatch, where whales and dolphins are accidentally caught in fishing gear
  • Creating safe homes for whales and dolphins

To find out more about our work visit www.whales.org or find WDC on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.

designandimplementciandcdpipelinesusingj.human_name: Design & Implement CI/CD Pipelines using Jenkins - Hands-On
designandimplementciandcdpipelinesusingj.description_text: This course introduces the fundamentals of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery and explains how automated pipelines streamline development, testing, and deployment workflows. You will begin by exploring the core principles of CI/CD and understanding how automation improves collaboration and accelerates release cycles in modern development environments. The learning journey then shifts to Jenkins, one of the most widely used automation servers for implementing CI/CD pipelines. Through guided demonstrations, you will install Jenkins in different environments, explore its architecture, and navigate its interface. You will create Jenkins jobs, configure build triggers, automate testing processes, and integrate source code repositories such as Git and GitHub. You will also learn how plugins, agents, and nodes support scalable build automation. The course then moves into pipeline-based automation. You will design multi-stage pipelines and integrate tools such as Docker and Ansible to support automated deployments. Advanced topics such as credential management, conditional stages, and parallel execution will help you build efficient pipelines and implement practical DevOps automation workflows.

practicaldevopsbootcampforall.description_text: Embark on an exciting journey through the DevOps lifecycle, where you’ll gain practical, real-world skills in GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD automation. The course starts with planning and version control using Git, followed by setting up a cloud infrastructure on AWS. You’ll dive deep into containerization with Docker and learn how to orchestrate and scale applications using Kubernetes. The curriculum is designed to provide step-by-step guidance, including hands-on demonstrations for setting up environments, deploying Python Flask applications, and scaling them for production. Throughout the course, you’ll explore real-time troubleshooting, providing you with the ability to handle DevOps challenges effectively. By the end of this course, you’ll be confident in using industry-standard DevOps tools. You’ll gain experience with GitHub Actions for automation, Prometheus for monitoring, and Grafana for visualization. This journey will empower you to apply DevOps principles in real-world scenarios and contribute to efficient application development and deployment.

practicalkubernetes_beyondckaandckadhand.human_name: Practical Kubernetes - Beyond CKA and CKAD Hands-on
practicalkubernetes_beyondckaandckadhand.description_text: This advanced Kubernetes course is designed for professionals seeking to go beyond certification exams like CKA and CKAD. It starts by laying a solid foundation with Kubernetes architecture and cluster setup. You'll then explore essential Kubernetes objects such as Pods, ReplicaSets, and Deployments, followed by practical hands-on demonstrations for configuring and managing them effectively. As you move deeper into the course, you'll master advanced Kubernetes concepts such as scaling, networking, and application rollouts. You'll learn about persistent storage, managing StatefulSets, and cluster upgrades. Notably, new sections introduce Pod Disruption Budgets (PDBs) and Kubernetes Events, providing critical tools for maintaining availability and troubleshooting in production environments. The course culminates with advanced monitoring techniques using Prometheus and Grafana, enabling you to track and visualize Kubernetes performance metrics. You'll also learn how to automate deployments using Helm charts, secure your environment using RBAC, and implement network policies. By the end, you'll be equipped to confidently manage Kubernetes clusters in real-world scenarios, solving complex problems with best practices.

terraformmastery_completehands-onguidewi.human_name: Terraform Mastery: Complete Hands-On Guide with Interview-Ready Prep
terraformmastery_completehands-onguidewi.description_text: This course explores infrastructure automation for modern cloud environments, helping you design, manage, and scale systems using Infrastructure as Code principles. You will begin with core concepts such as IaC, Terraform architecture, and AWS integration, enabling a smooth shift from manual provisioning to efficient, automated workflows. You will then dive into Terraform fundamentals, including providers, resources, state management, variables, and dependencies. Through hands-on labs, you will build AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, networking, and security setups while learning modules, provisioning, and reusable design patterns. This course is ideal for aspiring DevOps engineers, cloud professionals, and developers seeking practical automation skills. A basic understanding of cloud computing and AWS will help you maximize learning and apply concepts effectively in real scenarios. By the end of this course, you will learn how to automate infrastructure, manage state securely, build scalable Terraform modules, and apply best practices to real-world cloud environments with confidence.

automateyourdevopspipelineswithgithubact.human_name: Automate your DevOps pipelines with GitHub Actions
automateyourdevopspipelineswithgithubact.description_text: This course begins with the fundamentals of GitHub Actions, guiding you through the creation of your first workflow and how to include inputs. You’ll quickly advance to developing workflows specifically for .NET applications, building pipelines that can deploy to Azure. As you progress, you will gain practical experience in deploying infrastructure using Terraform and Bicep, learning to deploy and manage cloud resources directly from GitHub Actions. As you move deeper into the course, you’ll explore containerization and deployment, including pushing Docker images to container registries and integrating these steps into GitHub Actions workflows. You'll also dive into Kubernetes/AKS, learning the essentials of CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications, and building, pushing, and deploying images to Kubernetes clusters. The course also introduces cutting-edge GitHub Actions features like self-hosted runners, reusable workflows, and passwordless workflows using OIDC. It further expands your knowledge with advanced security features, such as GitHub Advanced Security and integrating Microsoft Defender for DevOps. By the end of the course, you will have the expertise to build robust and secure DevOps pipelines that automate the full software delivery lifecycle.

k8sgptessentials_unlockingkubernetesinsi.human_name: K8sGPT Essentials - Unlocking Kubernetes Insights with AI
k8sgptessentials_unlockingkubernetesinsi.description_text: This course helps professionals integrate Kubernetes (K8s) with AI through K8sGPT, an advanced tool offering AI-powered analysis of K8s clusters. You will begin by exploring K8sGPT's features, learning how it enhances Kubernetes management with improved documentation, real-time issue detection, and problem-solving automation. Practical demonstrations will guide you through installing and configuring K8sGPT on macOS and Kubernetes clusters. As you progress, you’ll learn how to effectively set up K8sGPT in different environments, use its command-line interface (CLI), and execute commands like analyze and filter. You’ll also explore integrating K8sGPT with leading AI platforms like Google Gemini and Amazon Bedrock. The course covers K8sGPT's core terminologies, processes, and its interaction with popular tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and KubeBuddy. The course includes hands-on demonstrations that showcase how to troubleshoot and enhance K8s dashboards with AI-driven insights. You’ll gain practical experience with in-cluster operator workflows, learning to scale, monitor, and automate Kubernetes clusters. By the end of the course, you’ll be equipped to optimize Kubernetes environments and leverage K8sGPT for powerful automation and analysis in your workflow.

opentelemetryinpractice_thecompleteobser.human_name: OpenTelemetry in Practice: The Complete Observability Course
opentelemetryinpractice_thecompleteobser.description_text: This course begins by establishing a strong foundation in observability, introducing metrics, logs, and traces along with service level objectives and error budgets. You will explore how modern systems are monitored and how different telemetry signals combine to provide deep insights into application behavior and performance. The journey then moves into building a complete observability stack using Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana. Through guided labs, you will configure, deploy, and validate each component while integrating them into a unified system. You will also gain practical experience with OpenTelemetry fundamentals, including APIs, SDKs, collectors, and semantic conventions. As you progress, the focus shifts to real-world instrumentation of applications. You will implement metrics, traces, and logs using both automatic and manual techniques, understand context propagation, and apply advanced patterns. The course culminates in deploying everything to Kubernetes, verifying telemetry pipelines, and troubleshooting distributed systems in a production-like environment.

pythonfordevops_theultimatehands-onguide.human_name: Python for DevOps: The Ultimate Hands-On Guide
pythonfordevops_theultimatehands-onguide.description_text: This course starts by guiding learners through setting up a Python environment tailored for DevOps tasks, covering version management, virtual environments, and interactive coding with JupyterLab. Students build a strong foundation in Python, including variables, loops, functions, data structures, and object-oriented programming, with practical DevOps exercises like disk usage calculation and log management. As the course progresses, learners dive into advanced Python features for DevOps, such as generators, decorators, exception handling, resource management, and logging practices. They gain hands-on experience with APIs, file handling, parsing JSON/YAML/CSV data, automating operations, and securely managing environment variables. The final sections focus on professional-grade development practices, including static typing, automated testing with Pytest, project structuring, and CI/CD pipeline creation. Students design command-line interfaces, integrate GitHub Actions workflows, implement linting and security checks, and automate deployment to PyPI. By the end, learners will be ready to solve complex DevOps challenges using Python, creating scalable, efficient, and automated solutions for modern infrastructures.

cloudnativebuildpacksfortheabsolutebegin.human_name: Cloud Native Buildpacks for the Absolute Beginners - Hands-on
cloudnativebuildpacksfortheabsolutebegin.description_text: This course begins by establishing a strong foundation in container images and the role of Buildpacks in modern application deployment. Early modules provide clarity on what Buildpacks are, their key features, and essential terminology, ensuring learners build a solid conceptual understanding. With clear demonstrations, users will navigate official documentation and essential tools like the Pack CLI, tailored for multiple operating systems. Progressing through practical applications, the course dives into building container images for popular languages including Python, Node.js, and Java. These demonstrations highlight how Buildpacks streamline complex workflows like integrating databases and managing build lifecycles. The hands-on approach ensures learners not only understand theoretical concepts but also gain real-world skills. Advanced sections focus on empowering users to create their own Buildpacks and Builders, with step-by-step guidance on customization and Procfile usage. The course culminates with an exploration of kpack, a Kubernetes-native Buildpack tool, showcasing environment setup, cluster configuration, and image publishing workflows. Throughout, learners are supported with detailed walkthroughs, preparing them to deploy cloud-native applications efficiently and confidently.

hands-onciandcdwithgithubactions_absolut.human_name: Hands-On CI/CD with GitHub Actions - Absolute Practical
hands-onciandcdwithgithubactions_absolut.description_text: In this course, you will gain practical experience in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. You will start by learning the fundamentals, including workflows, events, and triggers, before progressing to more advanced topics like self-hosted runners, Docker, Kubernetes, and custom GitHub Actions. The course is divided into sections that cover essential topics, including writing your first workflow, integrating popular tools like SonarCloud and CodeQL, and working with reusable workflows. Each section builds upon the previous one, taking you step-by-step through the process of automating development tasks. By the end of the course, you will be able to implement production-ready CI/CD pipelines that integrate security checks, deploy applications to Kubernetes, and automate testing and quality checks using a variety of tools and GitHub Actions features.

developers.developer-name: Yogesh Raheja, Thinknyx Technologies, Kulbhushan Mayer

jenkinsforbeginners.description_text: In this beginner-friendly course, you'll learn how to harness the power of Jenkins to automate your software development processes. Starting with the basics, you'll explore Jenkins' role in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and gain an understanding of its architecture and key features. The course will guide you through setting up Jenkins, from installation to navigating the user interface, and show you how to create and run projects using Freestyle Jobs. You’ll also learn how to link multiple jobs together to streamline workflows. As the course progresses, you'll dive into Jenkins pipelines, where you’ll discover how to define them using Jenkinsfiles, configure advanced pipeline settings, and integrate with Source Code Management (SCM) tools like Git. You’ll also explore Blue Ocean for visual pipeline creation and learn to manage pipeline parameters for dynamic execution. The course also covers automation using Jenkins CLI and APIs, allowing you to automate tasks programmatically. Security is emphasized, with practical lessons on CSRF protection, role-based access control, and secure Jenkins configuration. By the end, you'll have the knowledge and skills to implement Jenkins for automating, testing, and securing your software development pipeline.

kubernetesmasterclassforapplicationdevel.description_text: Dive into the world of Kubernetes with our expertly crafted masterclass designed specifically for application developers. We begin with an introduction to containers, where you'll learn what makes containers special, how to install Docker, and explore creating and managing Docker images. With hands-on exercises, you'll connect multiple containers and manage them using Docker Compose. Delve into core Kubernetes concepts, exploring its architecture and the role of each component within the control plane. Practical examples will guide you through understanding Pods, their lifecycle, namespaces, and manifest files. Step-by-step instructions will help you set up a local Kubernetes cluster with Minikube, execute basic kubectl commands, and deploy your first Pod. Advance to managing Pod lifecycles, services, and Ingress. Deploy a REST API, explore Init containers, and understand probes and hooks. Learn to manage access to Pods, implement ReplicaSets and Deployments, and configure rollout strategies. Finally, discover batch workflows, configuration and secret management, and storage handling. The course concludes with deploying your app on AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service, covering cluster creation, app deployment, and access through load balancers.

helmmasterclass_frombeginnertoadvanced.human_name: Helm Masterclass - From Beginner to Advanced
helmmasterclass_frombeginnertoadvanced.description_text: Dive into the world of Kubernetes package management with this in-depth Helm masterclass. Begin your journey by understanding the role of Helm in Kubernetes, its architecture, and how it compares to other tools. With step-by-step guidance, you’ll set up essential tools like Minikube, kubectl, and Visual Studio Code to ensure a smooth learning experience.  As you advance, you’ll master Helm’s core features, from discovering and installing charts to customizing deployments and managing releases. Learn to create custom Helm charts, leveraging Go templates and advanced templating techniques to build scalable, reusable solutions. Explore the power of Helm’s chart dependencies, subcharts, and hooks to elevate your Kubernetes projects.  By the end of the course, you’ll have the skills to confidently use Helm for managing Kubernetes resources. With a mix of theory and hands-on exercises, this course equips you to optimize deployments, troubleshoot issues, and integrate advanced features into your workflow, whether you’re a developer or DevOps professional.

fluxcdfortheabsolutebeginners_hands-onde.human_name: Flux CD for the Absolute Beginners - Hands-On DevOps
fluxcdfortheabsolutebeginners_hands-onde.description_text: This course introduces you to the world of GitOps and Flux CD, focusing on streamlining Kubernetes deployments through automation. You’ll begin by exploring GitOps concepts, followed by a comprehensive introduction to Flux CD and its core features. Hands-on demonstrations will guide you through the process of setting up Flux CD, understanding Flux CLI, and installing it on Kubernetes clusters.  Next, you’ll dive into deploying applications using Kustomize, Helm, and OCI Registry, learning the ins and outs of each tool to create efficient and scalable deployment pipelines. You’ll also explore Flux CD's advanced features such as image automation controllers, notification controllers, and its integration with monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana. By the end, you’ll gain valuable experience working with Flux CD’s UI and implementing security best practices to protect your deployment workflows.  Through practical demonstrations and real-world examples, this course equips you with the skills necessary to automate, monitor, and manage your Kubernetes deployments using GitOps and Flux CD. Whether you are an aspiring DevOps professional or looking to expand your Kubernetes knowledge, this course provides a solid foundation to take your skills to the next level.

ciandcdfortestautomation_jenkinsandgithu.human_name: CI/CD for Test Automation: Jenkins & GitHub Actions
ciandcdfortestautomation_jenkinsandgithu.description_text: In this course, you'll learn how to leverage Jenkins and GitHub Actions to automate tests and streamline CI/CD pipelines. Starting with CI/CD fundamentals, you’ll explore key concepts and tools before diving into hands-on setup for both Jenkins and GitHub Actions. You’ll build test automation pipelines that include unit tests, API, E2E, and performance testing, ensuring continuous testing throughout the development lifecycle. The course covers setting up complex test strategies, publishing test results, and managing thresholds for optimal test automation. You’ll also learn to deploy the BugTracker app manually, via Jenkins, and GitHub Actions to simulate real-world deployment workflows. Perfect for developers, QA engineers, and testers, this course offers practical examples and deep insights into CI/CD best practices, helping you enhance testing workflows, automation, and collaboration. Whether enhancing your skills or implementing automation in your team, this course provides everything you need to master CI/CD practices.

terraforminaction_buildandmanagecloudinf.human_name: Terraform in Action - Build & Manage Cloud Infrastructure
terraforminaction_buildandmanagecloudinf.description_text: This comprehensive course takes you step-by-step through Terraform's core concepts, starting with the creation of basic Terraform templates. You'll learn how to use Terraform for managing a wide range of cloud resources, focusing on Azure services like Web Apps, SQL Databases, and more. With practical demos, you'll explore creating templates, deploying applications, and handling variables to tailor your deployments. As you advance, you'll delve deeper into Terraform's execution plans, state management, and workspace configurations. Learn how Terraform can automate deployments across different environments, streamlining your infrastructure management. The course also covers deploying container services, PaaS offerings, IaaS, and advanced services like Logic Apps and Azure Firewall with Terraform. By the end of the course, you will have the confidence and skills to manage cloud infrastructures efficiently using Terraform. Whether deploying single resources or complex multi-environment setups, you’ll walk away with valuable hands-on experience.

automationwithansible_hands-ondevops.description_text: This course immerses you in the world of automation through Ansible, a leading tool in the DevOps field. Starting with a solid foundation, you will learn the installation process, configuration, and basic functionalities of Ansible before diving into more advanced topics. The course guides you through the essentials of Ansible, such as modules, inventory, and playbooks, with hands-on demonstrations and real-world scenarios. Throughout the course, you will progress from understanding Ansible’s foundational concepts to implementing complex automation solutions. You’ll master the creation and management of Ansible playbooks, learn how to manage Windows environments, and even get familiar with advanced features like Ansible Vault and AWX for streamlined automation. Each section builds on the last, allowing you to understand both the theoretical concepts and practical applications of Ansible automation. Whether you're looking to automate your infrastructure or streamline your DevOps pipelines, this course ensures you’ll leave with the skills necessary to deploy, manage, and troubleshoot your systems effectively. By the end, you'll be equipped to leverage Ansible’s full potential and contribute meaningfully to any automation-driven project.

masteringdockeressentials_hands-ondevops.description_text: Mastering Docker Essentials is designed for developers eager to dive into the world of containerization and DevOps with Docker. This course begins with a solid foundation, covering core Docker concepts like containers, images, and volumes, providing you with the knowledge to begin deploying applications seamlessly across environments. The hands-on exercises guide you through real-world examples, ensuring you grasp the practical applications of Docker from day one. As you progress, you'll explore more advanced topics such as Docker networking and volumes, which are essential for managing multi-container environments. The course also delves into optimizing Docker images through Dockerfiles, while demonstrating how to integrate Docker Compose for managing multi-container applications. Each section is geared toward ensuring you can build, manage, and scale Docker containers effectively and efficiently in your development lifecycle. Throughout the course, you'll leverage various environments, including local setups, Docker Hub, and even cloud-based Docker deployments, providing you with a holistic learning experience. By the end of this course, you'll be confident in deploying applications with Docker, managing containerized environments, and utilizing Docker's most powerful features in production.

dockerandkubernetesmasterclass_frombegin.human_name: Docker and Kubernetes Masterclass: From Beginner to Advanced
dockerandkubernetesmasterclass_frombegin.description_text: This course takes you from the fundamentals of containerization to deploying and managing applications in production-ready cloud-native environments. You begin by learning Docker architecture, containers, images, Dockerfiles, registries, networking, storage, resource management, and Docker Compose. Through hands-on exercises and projects, you will containerize web applications, optimize images, manage data persistence, and build multi-container solutions using real-world workflows. The journey then progresses into Kubernetes, covering cluster architecture, pods, services, manifests, ReplicaSets, Deployments, namespaces, resource management, probes, persistent storage, StatefulSets, ConfigMaps, Secrets, RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, and Kustomize. Practical labs and projects reinforce how to deploy, scale, secure, and operate applications effectively. The course concludes with deploying applications to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), working with ingress, load balancing, and cloud infrastructure. New hands-on labs cover AI-assisted Dockerfile optimization, Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA), and queue-based autoscaling with custom metrics. By the end of this course, you will confidently build, optimize, deploy, secure, scale, and manage production-ready applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

kubernetesandcloudnativeassociatekcnawit.human_name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) with Practice Exams
kubernetesandcloudnativeassociatekcnawit.description_text: This course is designed to guide you through the Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA) exam preparation. It starts with an introduction to containers, cloud-native computing, and Kubernetes evolution. You’ll explore Kubernetes components like Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets, and Services, building a solid foundation in container orchestration. Practical demonstrations and labs help you apply concepts to real-world scenarios.  As you progress, you'll dive into Kubernetes networking, object definitions, and best practices. Key topics such as Kubernetes security, storage, scheduling, and application delivery are thoroughly covered. The course also introduces Helm, Service Meshes, and observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana, preparing you for cloud-native infrastructure management.  Hands-on demonstrations and optional labs provide opportunities to practice setting up clusters, configuring services, and managing resources. The course wraps up with practice exams to test your knowledge and ensure you’re ready for the KCNA certification.  Anyone who wants to get familiar with the Containerization basics and Docker Fundamentals may refer this section - “Understanding Docker (Optional)” or if you are already familiar with Docker then feel free to skip this section.

cloud-native_microserviceskubernetesserv.human_name: Cloud-Native - Microservices, Kubernetes, Service Mesh, CI/CD
cloud-native_microserviceskubernetesserv.description_text: This course provides a complete journey into cloud-native development, teaching you to design, build, and deploy modern distributed systems. Start by understanding cloud-native principles, microservices, Kubernetes, and service meshes. Through hands-on projects, learn to build RESTful APIs using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB. Explore caching with Redis and ElastiCache, asynchronous communication with Kafka and RabbitMQ, and event-driven architectures for scalable solutions. Advance into Kubernetes orchestration, using horizontal scaling with HPA and event-driven scaling with KEDA. Deploy and manage workloads with Helm charts, automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, and create CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. Discover observability practices with Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing tools like Zipkin to monitor and troubleshoot systems effectively. With practical labs and real-world projects, this course equips you to modernize legacy systems or build cloud-native applications from scratch. Master the skills to design scalable, secure, and resilient architectures for today’s dynamic IT landscape.

dockerforaiandml.description_text: In this course, you’ll master Docker for AI/ML development, deployment, and maintenance. The course begins with an introduction to Docker’s significance in machine learning and AI, demonstrating how containers provide reproducibility and scalability. You will set up Docker environments to run ML tools, including Jupyter, MLFlow, and more, preparing you for tasks like packaging models and deploying them on production systems. The curriculum is structured around practical, project-based learning. You will progress from setting up basic ML environments to packaging ML applications as containerized images. The course dives into Dockerfiles, container operations, and how to integrate services using Docker Compose, allowing you to simulate production-grade systems. By exploring projects, such as deploying a house price prediction app or running LLMs locally, you’ll manage complex workflows in Docker. You’ll also explore Docker’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) Toolkit, essential for managing AI/ML applications, including agentic AI and LLMs. By the end, you’ll be able to deploy AI models locally, create reproducible environments, and automate pipelines with Docker.

devopsandgenaiusingnetazureopenaiandgith.human_name: DevOps and GenAI using .NET, Azure OpenAI and GitHub
devopsandgenaiusingnetazureopenaiandgith.description_text: This course begins by establishing a strong foundation in Generative AI within the DevOps ecosystem, explaining how AI enhances efficiency, decision-making, and automation across the software delivery lifecycle. Learners explore key concepts such as AI-assisted versus autonomous DevOps, along with critical risk considerations including hallucinations, model drift, and operational reliability. The course then transitions into practical implementation, where learners apply AI to real DevOps scenarios such as infrastructure as code, pipeline generation, testing strategies, release automation, and incident response. Through guided demonstrations, learners gain hands-on experience integrating AI into workflows using tools like .NET, Azure OpenAI, and GitHub, improving speed, consistency, and delivery outcomes. In the final phase, advanced topics such as enterprise governance, secure integration patterns, and agentic AI systems are explored in depth. Learners design intelligent pipelines, orchestrate AI-driven workflows, and implement autonomous agents with observability and control, enabling scalable, secure, and production-ready DevOps practices aligned with modern enterprise needs.

introductiontodevopsfundamentalsforitand.human_name: Introduction to DevOps Fundamentals for IT and Software Professionals
introductiontodevopsfundamentalsforitand.description_text: This course serves as a comprehensive introduction to DevOps, emphasizing its role in fostering collaboration between IT and software teams. Beginning with core concepts, learners will explore DevOps' evolution, its value, and its challenges. The course delves into the tools and practices that drive DevOps, including continuous integration, delivery, and deployment. You'll also discover the importance of infrastructure as code and how automation enhances team efficiency. In the second section, you will dive into key practices, including configuration management with Ansible and building situational awareness. Learn how to implement and monitor critical processes like continuous delivery, as well as managing environments with Docker and Kubernetes. The course concludes by preparing you for real-world industry applications, showcasing platforms like Jenkins, GitHub, and ServiceNow, and offering hands-on experience with automation tools like Terraform and Selenium. Throughout the course, you’ll gain insights into the tools that make DevOps a key driver for IT professionals today. Whether you're new to DevOps or looking to deepen your expertise, this course equips you with the foundational knowledge to succeed in DevOps-driven organizations and prepares you for a career path in this rapidly growing field.

wdc_gamersfororcas.description_text:
Donations to support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are made to the PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the conservation and protection of whales and dolphins. We defend these remarkable creatures against the many threats they face through campaigns, lobbying, advising governments, conservation projects, field research and rescue. Our mission is to amaze people with the wonder of whales and dolphins, and inspire global action to protect them. Our vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

WDC has offices in the UK, US, Germany and South America and currently works on a range of campaigns, including:

  • Ending hunting and commercial whaling
  • Helping to tackle ocean plastic pollution, which poses a serious threat to whales and dolphins
  • Ending  keeping  whales and dolphins  in captivity
  • Tackling the issue of bycatch, where whales and dolphins are accidentally caught in fishing gear
  • Creating safe homes for whales and dolphins

To find out more about our work visit www.whales.org or find WDC on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.

Girls Who Code, a nonprofit organization, was founded in 2012 to encourage more young women to complete a college-level computer science education and gain skills to further enhance their employability. Mobilizing leading executives, educators, and engineers, Girls Who Code has developed a new model of computer science education designed to inspire, educate, and equip girls of all experience levels and backgrounds with the skills to succeed in the field.

In just three years, Girls Who Code has already begun to move the needle: through rapid iteration and expansion of our Summer Immersion Program and highly-scalable Clubs Program, Girls Who Code has delivered 3,000+ hours of instruction to 3,000+ girls nationwide. Our programs have earned support from the CEOs of top Fortune 500 companies, engaged 700+ industry professionals, delivered among the most robust dataset on computer science education, and been featured in 100+ publications, from The New York Times to the Today Show. Our alumnae are overwhelmingly choosing to major in computer science or related studies and consistently name Girls Who Code's programs as their chief incentive to do so.

Girls Who Code is dedicated to closing the gender gap in the technology world. Supporting the work of Girls Who Code is an opportunity to empower the engineers, innovators, and executives of tomorrow.

completedrawingcourse.description_text:
Even if you think you can’t draw, you can.

This course builds core drawing fundamentals, stroke, shape, depth, form and shading, through fun, creative practice rather than dry repetition.

Sketch quirky game objects and weapons, craft vibrant characters with proper dimensions and poses, then dive into 3D shapes, isometric drawing and one and two point perspective for full game scenes.

Follow along with pen and paper or a graphics tablet, whichever you’ve got.

With regular challenges and carefully paced lessons, you’ll build real skill while creating concept art for characters, environments, props and spaceships along the way.

blenderlowpolylandscapes.description_text:
Building a landscape is a different job to just placing assets in a scene, this course walks you through it from Blender’s core menus and meshes to a full low poly environment complete with ponds, trees and houses.

You’ll use loop cuts and mirror modifiers to shape terrain and repeat details without modelling everything twice, then apply multiple materials so the scene stops looking like a blockout and starts looking like somewhere.

Light your world deliberately to set the mood, cosy or battle arena, and render it out in both Cycles and Eevee to see how each handles your choices.

By the end you’ll have a complete, game-ready landscape and a personal low poly style to carry into future scenes.

blendermaterialnodescourse.description_text:
Want to create stunning custom materials in Blender without relying on image textures?

Master Blender’s node system to build procedural shaders from scratch.

From mud and wood to bricks and beyond, learn step by step how to make materials that are flexible, customisable and totally royalty free.

Level up your understanding of utility nodes, vector math and node based workflows with plenty of hands on projects.

Grab the bundle and create textures like a pro, straight from the node editor.

hardsurfacemodellinginblendercourse.human_name: Hard Surface Modelling in Blender Course
hardsurfacemodellinginblendercourse.description_text:
Learn Blender’s hard surface modelling workflow by building a fully stylised car from the ground up, starting with simple shapes and smart topology, then shaping detail with edge loops, modifiers and creases until it feels solid and game-ready.

Customise the style, colours and accessories to make it your own, then finish with lighting, shading and rendering for that final polish.

You’ll come away with clean, non-destructive modelling skills, control over edge flow and support loops, and the confidence to model anything with bold shapes and clean detail, vehicles, robots, spaceships and beyond.

blenderlandscapescourse.description_text:
Want to create stunning landscapes in Blender that actually work in your projects?

This course shows you how to design, sculpt and texture detailed environments using pro tools like geometry nodes, vertex painting and weight painting.

Start from 2D map sketches, block out your terrain, then use procedural systems and hand crafted control to place vegetation and bring your scene to life.

Perfect for game devs, cinematic artists or anyone who loves world building.

Build beautiful, controllable landscapes, no randomness, just results.

blenderenvironmentartistcourse.description_text:
Ever wanted to build the kind of 3D environments you’d actually see in a game? This course gets you there.

Start with a fun modular castle, build up to a detailed spooky corridor with lighting and atmosphere, then create a full outdoor scene, rocks, trees, landscape and a medieval house, all from modular pieces that slot together cleanly.

Everything you build goes straight into Blender’s Asset Browser, so every window, door, rock and tree becomes part of your own personal asset pack, ready to drag into any future project.

No experience needed, you’ll learn multiple modelling techniques from quick and simple to detailed and high end, plus PBR materials and professional lighting, so you know exactly which tool to reach for and when.

By the end you’ll have a full library of game-ready assets and environments worth showing off.

blenderalphabrushpack_rockstone.human_name: Blender Alpha Brush Pack: Rock and Stone
blenderalphabrushpack_rockstone.description_text:
Transform your 3D sculpts with the ultimate rock and stone Blender alpha brush pack.

Whether you’re carving rugged mountains, age old stone formations or realistic rocky terrain, this collection is your secret weapon for detail that makes viewers want to reach out and touch it.

Get 113 alpha brushes covering general, rock and stone ground textures, plus 113 alpha textures and a fully equipped .blend file.

Add a layer of authenticity to your work that standard modelling can’t match.

geometrynodesinblendercourse.description_text:
Ready to learn a powerful tool for non-destructive, procedural modelling?

Geometry Nodes lets you build complex 3D models that would be slow or painful to make by hand, with changes rippling automatically through your node trees instead of forcing you to start over.

You’ll learn the core concepts, data types, fields, boolean math, then put them to work manipulating meshes and curves directly in the node editor.

Build a modifier that populates any mesh with a low poly forest, complete with trees, rocks, bushes and grass, then use curves to create your own objects, from simple grass and leaves to fencing that follows terrain automatically and a full stylised tree generator.

Save and reuse your node setups to speed up every future project.

blendergameassetscourse_spaceships.description_text:
Ready to take your game assets to the next level?

Learn to build jaw dropping starships quickly using clever kitbashing techniques, no more hours lost to modelling frustration.

Perfect for game developers, concept artists and illustrators looking to boost their skills.

Build a library of reusable parts, texture like a pro and keep a consistent style across every ship you create.

Grab the bundle and let your creativity blast off.

blenderskillbuilder_modellingchallenges.description_text:

This course gives you a series of fun, bite sized challenges designed to push your creativity and build confidence.

Tackle objects of increasing complexity, each one focused on different modelling techniques and problem solving skills.

Perfect once you’ve done a beginner course and want to level up through practice.

No filler, just hands on Blender modelling that gets you better, faster.

blendertexturepaintingcourse.description_text:
Want to create stylised models in Blender that you can place in your games?

Learn modelling techniques for hand painted objects, giving them a fun, quirky, stylised look.

Learn how to unwrap and set up for texture painting. Find out how to quickly and easily create different textures for some of the most popular, such as wood, rock, grass, stone and metals.

The course is created at a ""real time"" pace, allowing you to follow along and create your models at the same time as the instructors without needing to stop and start the video. Nothing is skipped or speeded up, so you get to see the entire workflow.

A basic knowledge of blender interface would be helpful. If you’re a game asset artist, or an artist wanting to make use of your skills to create 3D assets, this course is perfect for you!

Become a Blender pro by mastering the super impressive technique of texture painting!

Master detailed dioramas, like a wizard’s workshop, perfect for game environments or just to impress your portfolio.

Easy to follow lessons and insider tips to speed up your workflow and create magical, immersive worlds.

Donations to support Make-A-Wish are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

Make-A-Wish® creates life-changing wishes for children with critical illnesses. We seek to bring every eligible child's wish to life because a wish is an integral part of a child's treatment journey. Research shows children who have wishes granted can build the physical and emotional strength they need to fight their illness. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, Make-A-Wish is the world’s leading children’s wish-granting organization, serving children in more than 50 countries worldwide. Together, generous donors, supporters, staff and more than 40,000 volunteers, grant a wish every 17 minutes, on average, somewhere in the world. Since 1980, Make-A-Wish has granted nearly 450,000 wishes to children; more than 30,000 last year alone. For more information about Make-A-Wish International, visit worldwish.org and for more information about Make-A-Wish America, visit wish.org.

teacup.description_text:
Teacup is a short and wholesome narrative adventure game with a focus on exploration and non-linear progression.

You play as the titular Teacup, a shy and introverted young frog who loves drinking tea and reading. The day before she is to host a tea party at her house, she realizes she is completely out of tea, and thus must venture into the woods around her to find the herbs she needs to restock her pantry.

You are free to tackle the list of ingredients Teacup must gather in any order you wish. Find your own path through the world of Little Pond.

During your adventure you will meet the charming inhabitants of the forest. Some are talkative, some are grumpy, but all of them will lend you an ear on your adventure.

Most of the animals you meet will be glad to help Teacup… in exchange for a small favor or some help. Organize a (oddly shaped) market stall, win an underwater race and more!

monsterprom2_monstercamp.description_text:
"Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

The original Monster Prom is a multiplayer dating sim that shines for its beautiful art and unapologetic humor.

The sequel brings you into a new setup (summer camp) with new characters to romance, including old faces and new ones: Damien, Calculester, Milo, Dahlia, Joy and Aaravi. But that's not all, Monster Camp comes with twists here and there: from the campfire mechanics to a new stage full of magic mixed drinks.

We're repeating the best from the popular "Monster Prom" formula, but adding some new spices to it. You will see ;)
